lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੇ ਕੀਨਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: gurasabade keenaa ridai nivaas ||3||
lines.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad has come to dwell within my heart. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਮਰਥ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur samarath sadaa daiaal ||
lines.translation: The Guru is All-powerful and Merciful forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: har jap jap naanak bhae nihaal ||4||11||
lines.translation: Chanting and meditating on the Lord, Nanak is exalted and enraptured. ||4||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur gur karat sadaa sukh paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Chanting Guru, Guru, I have found eternal peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਅਪਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਪਿ ਜਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: deen daiaal bhae kirapaalaa apanaa naam aap japaaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: God, Merciful to the meek, has become kind and compassionate; He has inspired me to chant His Name. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)gat mil bhaiaa pragaas ||
lines.translation: Joining the Society of the Saints, I am illumined and enlightened.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਈ ਆਸ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har har japat pooran bhaee aas ||1||
lines.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, my hopes have been fulfilled. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਸੂਖ ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab kaliaan sookh man voothe ||
lines.translation: I am blessed with total salvation, and my mind is filled with peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੂਠੇ ॥੨॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: har gun gaae gur naanak toothe ||2||12||
lines.translation: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; O Nanak, the Guru has been gracious to me. ||2||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਬਿਭਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 5 ghar 2 bibhaas ||
lines.translation: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Bibhaas:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਠਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: avar na doojaa thaau ||
lines.translation: There is no other place of rest,

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਹੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: naahee bin har naau ||
lines.translation: none at all, without the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸਿਧਿ ਕਲਿਆਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab sidh kaliaan ||
lines.translation: There is total success and salvation,

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: pooran hohi sagal kaam ||1||
lines.translation: and all affairs are perfectly resolved. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਨੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ko naam japeeai neet ||
lines.translation: Constantly chant the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਲਗੈ ਏਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh aha(n)kaar binasai lagai ekai preet ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Sexuality, anger and egotism are wiped away; let yourself fall in love with the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਦੂਖੁ ਭਾਗੈ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਾਲਨ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam laagai dookh bhaagai saran paalan jog ||
lines.translation: Attached to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, pain runs away. In His Sanctuary, He cherishes and sustains us.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਜਮੁ ਨ ਤੇਟੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: satigur bhetai jam na tetai jis dhur hovai sa(n)jog ||2||
lines.translation: Whoever has such pre-ordained destiny meets with the True Guru; the Messenger of Death cannot grab him. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੈਨਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਜਹੁ ਮਨ ਕੇ ਭਰਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: rain dinas dhiaai har har tajahu man ke bharam ||
lines.translation: Night and day, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har; abandon the doubts of your mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਰਮ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat har milai jisahi pooran karam ||3||
lines.translation: One who has perfect karma joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and meets the Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਬਿਖਾਦ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਆਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam janam bikhaad binase raakh leene aap ||
lines.translation: The sins of countless lifetimes are erased, and one is protected by the Lord Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਮੀਤ ਭਾਈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: maat pitaa meet bhaaee jan naanak har har jaap ||4||1||13||
lines.translation: He is our Mother, Father, Friend and Sibling; O servant Nanak, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||1||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਬਿਭਾਸ ਪੜਤਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 5 bibhaas paRataal ||
lines.translation: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl, Bibhaas, Partaal:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਜਾਪ ॥
lines.transliteration: ram raam raam raam jaap ||
lines.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਅਹੰ ਤਾਪ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kal kales lobh moh binas jaai aha(n) taap ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Conflict, suffering, greed and emotional attachment shall be dispelled, and the fever of egotism shall be relieved. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸੰਤ ਚਰਨ ਲਾਗਿ ਮਨੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਜਾਹਿ ਪਾਪ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aap tiaag sa(n)t charan laag man pavit jaahi paap ||1||
lines.translation: Renounce your selfishness, and grasp the feet of the Saints; your mind shall be sanctified, and your sins shall be taken away. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਰਾਖਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak baarik kachhoo na jaanai raakhan kau prabh maaee baap ||2||1||14||
lines.translation: Nanak, the child, does not know anything at all. O God, please protect me; You are my Mother and Father. ||2||1||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਨਿ ਟੇਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal saran tek ||
lines.translation: I have taken the Shelter and Support of the Lord's Lotus Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਮੂਚ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਰਬ ਊਪਰਿ ਤੁਹੀ ਏਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ooch mooch bea(n)t thaakur sarab oopar tuhee ek ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You are Lofty and Exalted, Grand and Infinite, O my Lord and Master; You alone are above all. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ਦੁਖ ਬਿਦਾਰ ਦੈਨਹਾਰ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: praan adhaar dukh bidaar dainahaar budh bibek ||1||
lines.translation: He is the Support of the breath of life, the Destroyer of pain, the Giver of discriminating understanding. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਰਖਨਹਾਰ ਮਨਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮੇਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: namasakaar rakhanahaar man araadh prabhoo mek ||
lines.translation: So bow down in respect to the Savior Lord; worship and adore the One God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨੁ ਕਰਉ ਮਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੁਖ ਅਨੇਕ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t ren karau majan naanak paavai sukh anek ||2||2||15||
lines.translation: Bathing in the dust of the feet of the Saints, Nanak is blessed with countless comforts. ||2||2||15||
